documents: Senior Frontend Engineer. We are looking for an engineer with deep React and TypeScript experience to build accessible, high performance web applications. You will own our design system, drive Core Web Vitals improvements, write unit tests with Jest and end to end tests with Playwright, and collaborate with product and design. Experience with Next.js, state management libraries such as Redux or Zustand, and CI/CD pipelines is required.

Backend Engineer. Design and operate scalable REST APIs and event driven microservices in Node.js and TypeScript. You will model data in PostgreSQL and Redis, instrument observability with metrics and tracing, and deploy containers with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS. Familiarity with message queues such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and infrastructure as code with Terraform is a strong plus.

Data Engineer. Build and maintain batch and streaming pipelines with Apache Spark, Airflow, and dbt. You will model a cloud data warehouse in BigQuery or Snowflake, own ETL and ELT workloads, enforce data quality checks, and partner with analysts. Strong SQL and Python skills are mandatory, and experience with GCP or AWS is expected.

Data Analyst. Turn raw data into decisions: write advanced SQL, build dashboards in Power BI, Looker Studio, or Tableau, and communicate insights to stakeholders. You will define KPIs with business teams, automate reports in Python with pandas, and validate experiments with basic statistics. Experience with spreadsheet modeling in Excel is welcome.

Machine Learning Engineer. Train, evaluate, and ship models to production. You will build pipelines with PyTorch or TensorFlow, serve models behind APIs, monitor drift, and optimize inference latency. Solid Python engineering, experience with scikit-learn, NLP or LLM applications, and MLOps practices such as experiment tracking are required.

DevOps Engineer. Own our CI/CD platform end to end: GitHub Actions pipelines, Docker images, Kubernetes clusters, and Terraform managed infrastructure across AWS accounts. You will improve observability with monitoring and alerting, harden security, automate incident response, and champion infrastructure as code and GitOps practices.

Fullstack Developer. Ship features across a React and Node.js stack with TypeScript end to end. You will design GraphQL and REST APIs, model data in PostgreSQL and MongoDB, write tests with Vitest and Cypress, and deploy to serverless platforms. Comfort moving between frontend accessibility work and backend performance tuning is essential.

Mobile Developer. Build and maintain native and cross platform mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native or Flutter. You will integrate REST APIs, implement offline first storage, handle push notifications, optimize startup time, and publish releases to both app stores with automated CI/CD pipelines.

QA Automation Engineer. Design test strategies and build automated suites with Playwright, Cypress, and Selenium. You will define quality gates in CI/CD, write API and contract tests, track flaky tests, and coach developers on TDD and unit testing practices. Strong scripting skills in JavaScript or Python are required.

Site Reliability Engineer. Keep a high traffic platform reliable: define SLOs, build monitoring and alerting, run capacity planning, and lead blameless postmortems. You will automate toil with Python and Bash, operate Kubernetes and Linux systems at scale, and tune PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch clusters.

Security Engineer. Protect our applications and cloud infrastructure. You will run threat modeling, review code for vulnerabilities, manage OAuth and JWT based authentication flows, harden AWS and Kubernetes configurations, respond to incidents, and build security automation into CI/CD pipelines.

Engenheiro de Dados. Construa pipelines de dados escaláveis com Apache Spark, Airflow e dbt, modelando um data warehouse em BigQuery ou Snowflake. Você vai dominar SQL e Python, garantir qualidade de dados em processos ETL e ELT, otimizar custos em GCP ou AWS e apoiar times de analytics e business intelligence.

Desenvolvedor Frontend Pleno. Procuramos pessoa desenvolvedora com sólida experiência em React, TypeScript e Tailwind para evoluir nossa plataforma web. Você vai construir interfaces acessíveis, otimizar performance, escrever testes com Jest e Playwright, participar de code review e colaborar com design em um time ágil com Scrum.

Analista de Dados. Transforme dados em decisões: escreva SQL avançado, construa dashboards em Power BI e Looker Studio, automatize relatórios com Python e pandas e apresente insights para stakeholders. Desejável experiência com Excel avançado, modelagem de indicadores e noções de estatística.

Desenvolvedor Backend. Projete e mantenha APIs REST e microsserviços em Node.js com TypeScript, modelando dados em PostgreSQL e Redis. Você vai trabalhar com Docker, Kubernetes e AWS, aplicar boas práticas de testes unitários, mensageria com Kafka e observabilidade com métricas e logs estruturados.

Product Manager. Own the roadmap for a B2B SaaS product: run discovery interviews, define specs and success metrics, prioritize a backlog with engineering in agile ceremonies such as Scrum and Kanban, analyze funnels and retention data with SQL dashboards, and communicate strategy to leadership and customers.

Product Designer. Craft user centered flows from research to polished UI. You will run usability tests, build prototypes and a scalable design system in Figma, partner with engineers on accessibility standards, and use analytics and A/B testing to validate design decisions across web and mobile surfaces.

Engineering Manager. Lead a team of eight engineers building cloud services. You will coach and grow individual contributors, run planning and retrospectives, own delivery of a microservices platform on Kubernetes, partner with product management on strategy, and keep technical debt, incident load, and hiring pipelines healthy.

Cloud Architect. Define reference architectures across AWS, Azure, and GCP: landing zones, networking, identity, and cost governance. You will lead migrations from on premise systems, standardize Terraform modules, review designs for security and resilience, and mentor platform teams on serverless and container patterns.

Business Intelligence Analyst. Own the semantic layer and executive dashboards in Power BI, mastering DAX and M code. You will model star schemas in a SQL data warehouse, automate refresh pipelines, document KPI definitions, and train business users on self service analytics.

Technical Writer. Create developer documentation for our public APIs and SDKs: tutorials, reference pages, and migration guides. You will work from OpenAPI specs, test code samples in JavaScript and Python, maintain docs as code in Git with CI checks, and partner with engineers on information architecture.

Customer Support Specialist. Resolve product questions across email and chat, reproduce bugs for engineering with clear reports, maintain a self service knowledge base, and surface customer feedback themes to product. Strong written communication and empathy are essential; familiarity with SQL for basic lookups is a plus.

Marketing Analyst. Plan and measure digital campaigns across paid and organic channels: SEO, content, and email. You will build attribution reports, analyze conversion funnels with SQL and spreadsheets, run A/B tests on landing pages, and present growth recommendations to leadership.

Financial Analyst. Build revenue models and budget forecasts, automate monthly reporting in Excel and Python, analyze variance against plan, and prepare board ready presentations. Experience with SQL, BI dashboards, and SaaS metrics such as ARR, churn, and CAC is preferred.
